info.title: StoreOS platform and employee workflow API
info.description: Single-company local writer. Platform, employee identity, immutable templates, atomic shift publication, and P1b.4 own confirmation-task execution. No measurement steps, offline writes or plugin task access.

post.description: Changes the authenticated account's own password after verifying the current password. Requires identity.self.password (granted to admin, auditor, viewer and employee). The request accepts no account identifier; the target is always the session account. Current-password verification, Argon2id re-hash, audit identity.user.password_changed and revocation of all sessions of the account (including the calling session) commit atomically. On success the calling token is immediately invalid and must not be used for follow-up requests. The operation is not blindly idempotent: a lost 204 leaves the outcome unknown and is recovered by signing in with the new password if committed, otherwise with the old password.

204.description: Password changed; all sessions of the account, including the calling session, were revoked. No response body.

400.description: invalid_request or invalid_json: missing or unknown properties, type mismatch, currentPassword empty or above 1024 UTF-8 bytes, newPassword outside 12 to 1024 UTF-8 bytes, or newPassword equal to currentPassword.

401.description: unauthorized: missing, malformed, revoked or expired session, or the account is disabled.

403.description: forbidden: the authenticated role lacks identity.self.password or the account is outside the configured company.

413.description: body_too_large: the request body exceeds 16384 bytes.

415.description: unsupported_media_type: the request content type is not application/json.

422.description: invalid_current_password: the supplied current password does not match; no password, session or audit state changed.

429.description: rate_limited: the account exceeded five failed current-password verifications within a 15-minute window; no hash verification or state change occurred.

503.description: database_unavailable: infrastructure failure; no state changed.

post.description: Requires workforce.shifts.manage; task reads also require tasks.instances.read. Admin only; same company and configured location. State and audit share one transaction; no integration events. Published shifts and snapshots cannot be changed. Create ID is bound to actor, location and original normalized content; identical retries return current state. Requires workforce.shifts.manage; task reads also require tasks.instances.read. Admin only; same company and configured location. Amends only the startsAt/endsAt interval of a published shift while every task instance is still pristine open; any started, blocked, completed or already cancelled instance refuses the whole request with 422 shift_in_progress and no writes. Employee, location and template selections cannot be changed. The requested interval must end after the database clock, stay inside the employee's assignment window and not overlap another published shift of that employee (409 shift_overlap). State, last-amendment evidence and audit share one transaction; no integration events. A current-version request with the identical interval is a no-op; a retry with the original expectedVersion, same actor and same interval returns the current state without new effects; a mismatching retry identity or stale version returns 409 shift_conflict. Earlier amendments remain only in the append-only audit.

Requires workforce.shifts.manage; task reads also require tasks.instances.read. Admin only; same company and configured location. Any started, blocked, completed or already cancelled instance refuses the whole request with 422 shift_in_progress and no writes. State, cancellation evidence and audit share one transaction; no integration events. A retry with the original expectedVersion, same actor and same normalized reason returns the existing cancelled state without new effects; a mismatching retry identity or stale version returns 409.

get.description: Requires inventory.articles.manage (admin only), current session and company scope. Articles are company-wide master data: no location ownership and no stock, supplier, purchasing or price data exists in this slice. Company-scoped keyset page ordered by id, at most 50 entries; after is the last article UUID and a malformed value returns 400 invalid_cursor. q is a literal case-insensitive name/SKU search where %, _ and backslash are literal characters, not SQL wildcards. active=true returns only active articles, active=false only inactive ones, omitted returns both. Reads do not modify state or audit.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: UUID of the last article. Stable ascending ID order; 50 rows per page. A malformed value returns 400 invalid_cursor.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Literal case-insensitive search over name and SKU; %, _ and backslash are literal characters.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: true returns only active articles, false only inactive ones, omitted returns all.

post.description: Requires inventory.articles.manage (admin only), current session and company scope. Creates a company-wide article with version 1 and isActive=true. The client-supplied id is the reconciliation key: a duplicate id, case-insensitive SKU or non-null barcode returns 409 already_exists with zero writes. SKU uniqueness folds ASCII letters only and preserves other characters exactly; barcode is opaque optional text. Writes and audit are atomic; no domain events.

get.description: Requires inventory.articles.manage (admin only), current session and company scope. Returns an own-company article including inactive ones; unknown or foreign ids return 404 without an existence leak.

post.description: Requires inventory.articles.manage (admin only), current session and company scope. Full replacement of the mutable attributes with an expectedVersion guard. A current-version request whose normalized attributes equal the stored row is a no-op returning the current state without a version bump or audit. A stale version returns 409 article_conflict; a SKU or barcode collision with another article returns 409 already_exists; both write nothing. Writes and audit are atomic; no domain events.

Requires inventory.articles.manage (admin only), current session and company scope. Version-guarded non-destructive lifecycle: the row is kept and is_active becomes false. A current-version request in the target state is a no-op without a version bump or audit; a stale version returns 409 article_conflict. There is no delete route or hard-delete path. Writes and audit are atomic; no domain events.

Requires inventory.articles.manage (admin only), current session and company scope. Version-guarded non-destructive lifecycle: is_active becomes true. A current-version request in the target state is a no-op without a version bump or audit; a stale version returns 409 article_conflict. Writes and audit are atomic; no domain events.

get.description: Requires inventory.assortment.manage (admin only), current session and company scope. Lists one location's assortment memberships with the embedded company article summary. The active query filter applies only to the membership state: active=true returns active memberships, active=false inactive ones, omitted returns both; an active membership may embed a globally inactive article, which is intentional. Company- and location-scoped keyset page ordered by association id, at most 50 entries; after is the last association UUID and a malformed value returns 400 invalid_cursor. q is a literal case-insensitive article name/SKU search where %, _ and backslash are literal characters. Unknown or foreign locations return 404. Reads do not modify state or audit.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: UUID of the last association. Stable ascending ID order; 50 rows per page. A malformed value returns 400 invalid_cursor.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Literal case-insensitive search over the embedded article name and SKU; %, _ and backslash are literal characters.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Filters the membership state only: true returns active memberships, false inactive ones, omitted returns all. Article activity is exposed separately in the embedded article.

post.description: Requires inventory.assortment.manage (admin only), current session and company scope. Enables one company article at the route's company location with version 1 and isActive=true. The server derives the company from the revalidated session; the client cannot pass authority fields. The client-supplied id is the reconciliation key: a duplicate id or an existing (article, location) pair, including an inactive one, returns 409 already_exists with zero writes; an inactive pair must be reactivated instead of recreated. An unknown location or article returns 404; a globally inactive article returns 409 article_inactive. Membership state and article state stay independent. Writes and audit are atomic; no domain events.

get.description: Requires inventory.assortment.manage (admin only), current session, company scope and the route location. Returns one membership including inactive memberships and globally inactive articles; unknown ids, ids of another location and unknown or foreign locations return 404 without an existence leak.

post.description: Requires inventory.assortment.manage (admin only), current session, company scope and the route location. Version-guarded non-destructive membership lifecycle: is_active becomes false and the row is kept. A stale expectedVersion returns 409 assortment_conflict before any target-state check, so a stale request is never a no-op; a current-version request already inactive returns the current state without a version bump or audit. Deactivation is always allowed with respect to the article state; article deactivation never mutates memberships. There is no delete route. Writes and audit are atomic; no domain events.

Requires inventory.assortment.manage (admin only), current session, company scope and the route location. Version-guarded non-destructive membership lifecycle: is_active becomes true and the existing row is reused, never duplicated. A stale expectedVersion returns 409 assortment_conflict before any target-state check, so a stale request is never a no-op; a current-version request already active returns the current state without a version bump or audit. Reactivating requires the company article to be globally active at the check point, otherwise 409 article_inactive; a later article deactivation leaves an active membership persisted but operationally unavailable. Writes and audit are atomic; no domain events.

get.description: Requires stock.levels.manage (admin only), current session and company scope. Lists one location's stock levels with the live company-article projection. The search is one complete stock-level query joined against the inventory-released article/location projection and keyset-paginated over the stock level id, at most 50 entries; there is no pre-truncated article candidate set, so every matching level stays reachable through pagination. A level whose article or assortment membership was deactivated afterwards remains visible with its live activity flags. after is the last stock level UUID and a malformed value returns 400 invalid_cursor. q is a literal case-insensitive article name/SKU search where %, _ and backslash are literal characters. Unknown or foreign locations return 404. Reads do not modify state or audit.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: UUID of the last stock level. Stable ascending ID order; 50 rows per page. A malformed value returns 400 invalid_cursor.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Literal case-insensitive search over the joined article name and SKU; %, _ and backslash are literal characters.

post.description: Requires stock.levels.manage (admin only), current session and company scope. Opens the first recorded on-hand quantity for one company article and the route's company location: version 1, exactly one server-generated opening movement with balanceVersion 1, and the immutable stockUnit snapshot of the current normalized Article.unit. The gate requires the article to exist (404 not_found), be globally active (409 article_inactive) and have an active assortment membership at the location (409 not_in_assortment for an absent or inactive membership). The quantity is an exact decimal string scaled to thousandths, 0 to 999999999999.999; note is a required key whose value may be null; a non-null value must be trimmed, non-empty, at most 500 runes and free of control characters. The client-supplied id is the reconciliation key: a duplicate id or an existing (company, location, article) level returns 409 already_exists with zero writes; an existing level must be adjusted instead of reopened. A later Article.unit edit never changes an opened level's stockUnit. Writes and audit commit atomically; no domain events.

get.description: Requires stock.levels.manage (admin only), current session, company scope and the route location. Returns one stock level including levels whose article or assortment membership was deactivated afterwards; both live activity flags stay visible and the immutable stockUnit is returned next to the live Article.unit. Unknown ids, ids of another location and unknown or foreign locations return 404 without an existence leak. Reads do not modify state or audit.

post.description: Requires stock.levels.manage (admin only), current session, company scope and the route location. Absolute manual correction of the on-hand quantity. movementId is the operation identity and is checked before any stale-version handling: an exact replay (same level, company, location, actor, expectedVersion, target quantity and note) returns 200 with the current authoritative level and writes no new movement, version bump or audit, even after later movements advanced the level. Reusing the same movementId with any different level, scope, actor, expectedVersion, target or note returns 409 operation_conflict with zero writes. A real adjustment stores delta = target - current together with balanceAfter and the new balanceVersion; note is the required correction reason (non-empty, at most 500 runes). A matching-version request whose target equals the current quantity is a no-op without movement, version bump or audit. A stale expectedVersion returns 409 stock_conflict. Targets are non-negative; there is no negative-stock behavior. Writes and audit commit atomically; no domain events.

get.description: Requires stock.levels.manage (admin only), current session, company scope and the route location. Returns the immutable movement history of the route-scoped stock level, ordered by balanceVersion descending, at most 50 rows per page; after is the decimal balanceVersion of the last returned movement and a malformed or out-of-range value returns 400 invalid_cursor. Ordering never uses recordedAt. Each movement exposes delta and balanceAfter as exact decimal strings and inherits the level's immutable stockUnit; there is no unit per movement. Unknown level ids and ids of another location return 404. Reads do not modify state or audit.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The balanceVersion of the last returned movement. Strictly descending balanceVersion order; 50 rows per page. A malformed value returns 400 invalid_cursor.

pluginToken.description: Separate approved, scoped, expiring external client identity.

currentPassword.description: Non-empty and at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes. The StoreOS policy is byte-based, so minLength/maxLength (character counts) are deliberately not used; x-storeos-min-utf8-bytes and x-storeos-max-utf8-bytes carry the exact limits.

newPassword.description: 12 to 1024 UTF-8 bytes and different from currentPassword. The StoreOS policy is byte-based, so minLength/maxLength (character counts) are deliberately not used; x-storeos-min-utf8-bytes and x-storeos-max-utf8-bytes carry the exact limits.

name.description: No leading/trailing whitespace or control characters.

vendor.description: No leading/trailing whitespace or control characters.

token.description: Shown once; secret. Never persist in client logs.

correlationId.description: Server operation correlation; null on historical records.

AdminEvent.description: Versioned envelope; administrative view also includes processing status. Plugin view omits actor information.

TaskTemplateContent.description: Text must contain valid Unicode scalar values; isolated UTF-16 surrogates are rejected. Normalized compact UTF-8 JSON is limited to 8192 bytes. Step IDs must be unique. Empty steps are allowed only in drafts; publication requires at least one step.

TemplateRevision.description: Published revisions are immutable. Publication metadata is null for drafts and required for published revisions.

startsAt.description: Explicit UTC or numeric offset required; response normalized to UTC.

endsAt.description: Explicit UTC or numeric offset required; response normalized to UTC.

selections.description: Ordered, unique template IDs; every selected revision must be published at the same location. Publication requires at least one selection.

startsAt.description: Explicit UTC or numeric offset required; response normalized to UTC.

endsAt.description: Explicit UTC or numeric offset required; response normalized to UTC.

selections.description: Ordered, unique template IDs; every selected revision must be published at the same location. Publication requires at least one selection.

reason.description: Normalized cancellation reason; leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed and control characters are rejected.

startsAt.description: Explicit UTC or numeric offset required; response normalized to UTC. Must be before endsAt.

endsAt.description: Explicit UTC or numeric offset required; response normalized to UTC. Must be after startsAt and after the database clock.

startsAt.description: Explicit UTC or numeric offset required; response normalized to UTC.

endsAt.description: Explicit UTC or numeric offset required; response normalized to UTC.

selections.description: Ordered, unique template IDs; every selected revision must be published at the same location. Publication requires at least one selection.

createdAt.description: Explicit UTC or numeric offset required; response normalized to UTC.

updatedAt.description: Explicit UTC or numeric offset required; response normalized to UTC.

cancelledAt.description: Present exactly when status is cancelled; acknowledgement time of the terminal cancellation.

cancelledBy.description: Present exactly when status is cancelled; the cancelling account.

cancellationReason.description: Present exactly when status is cancelled.

cancellationVersion.description: Present exactly when status is cancelled; the request's original expectedVersion, used for lost-response retry recognition.

amendedAt.description: Present exactly when any amendment has been committed; acknowledgement time of the most recent amendment. Earlier amendments remain only in the append-only audit.

amendedBy.description: Present exactly when any amendment has been committed; the account of the most recent amendment.

amendmentVersion.description: Present exactly when any amendment has been committed; the request's original expectedVersion of the most recent amendment, used for lost-response retry recognition.

acceptedVersion.description: Aggregate version at acceptance. Absent in legacy stored receipts.

activeBlockingId.description: Present only while blocked; history is fetched separately.

cancelledAt.description: Present only for cancelled tasks. Derived from the terminal blocking disposition, or from the shift cancellation for an instance cancelled while pristine open.

cancelledBy.description: Present only for cancelled tasks. Derived from the terminal blocking disposition, or from the shift cancellation for an instance cancelled while pristine open.

cancelledBlockingId.description: Present only for blocked-origin cancellation, derived from the terminal blocking disposition; absent for an instance cancelled while pristine open.

reason.description: CRLF normalized to LF and trimmed; Unicode codepoints; only tab/newline control characters allowed.

resolutionKind.description: Null for open blocking. Legacy resolved records without this property mean resumed. Cancellation does not assert remediation.

TaskDecimal.description: Exact decimal, no exponent, grouping or rounding; -999999.999 to 999999.999. Canonical responses remove leading/trailing zeros and negative zero.

instruction.description: Plain text. LF/tab allowed; other control characters rejected. Trimmed on write.
Plain text. LF/tab allowed; other control characters rejected. Trimmed on write.

NumericStep.description: Inclusive minimum <= maximum; display-only unit. Requires content schema 2.

stockUnit.description: Immutable unit-label snapshot taken at opening.

quantity.description: Exact decimal, no exponent, grouping or rounding; 0 to 999999999999.999. Canonical responses remove leading/trailing zeros.

assortmentIsActive.description: Live membership state. Effective availability is article.isActive && assortmentIsActive, computed by the client and deliberately not stored.

delta.description: Exact signed decimal delta as thousandths; zero never carries a sign.

balanceAfter.description: Exact decimal balance after this movement; 0 to 999999999999.999.

nextCursor.description: Decimal balanceVersion of the last returned movement when another page exists.

quantity.description: Exact opening quantity, 0 to 999999999999.999; a negative target is invalid.

note.description: Required key with a nullable value; a non-null note must be non-blank after trimming.

movementId.description: Client-generated operation identity; exact replays are idempotent and any other reuse is 409 operation_conflict.

note.description: Required correction reason; non-blank after trimming.
